sqlquery.from: ( select cev.id as id, cev.callLog as calllog, cev.subject as subject, case when cev.callLog = 'true' then 'Call Log' ELSE 'Events' end as activitytype, cev.enddate as duedate, cev.deleted as deleted, array_to_string(array_agg(a.firstName||' '||a.lastname), ', ') as assignee, cev.description, cev.startdate, cev.venue from "$".event cev left join (select empevn.event_id as id, myu.firstName as firstName, myu.lastname as lastname from "$".employeeevent empevn inner join "$".myuser myu on empevn.employee_id = myu.id where empevn.deleted is not true) a on a.id = cev.id WHERE cev.deleted is not true group by cev.id, cev.callLog, cev.subject, duedate, cev.deleted, cev.description, cev.startdate, cev.venue ) t LEFT JOIN "$".relation rel on ((rel.toid = t.id and rel.totype = 'event') or (rel.fromid = t.id and rel.fromtype = 'event'))

join-conditions.join: LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontact ld ON ((rel.toid = ld.id and rel.totype = 'lead') or (rel.fromid = ld.id and rel.fromtype = 'lead'))
LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontact crmcon ON ((rel.toid = crmcon.id and rel.totype = 'contact') or (rel.fromid = crmcon.id and rel.fromtype = 'contact'))
LEFT JOIN "$".opportunity opp ON ((rel.toid = opp.id and rel.totype = 'opportunity') or (rel.fromid = opp.id and rel.fromtype = 'opportunity'))
LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontact cco ON ((rel.toid = cco.id and rel.totype = 'account') or (rel.fromid = cco.id and rel.fromtype = 'account'))
LEFT JOIN "$".crmcase crc ON ((rel.toid = crc.id and rel.totype = 'case') or (rel.fromid = crc.id and rel.fromtype = 'case'))
